methodology: Seven additional real cases selected before any model evaluation because their public editorial API material is available. They supplement, never silently replace, inaccessible entries in tag-cases.v1.json. Report access coverage for the combined cohort. Cases overlap contests and are not a representative random sample. Expected methods and notes are evaluation-only, never model input.

cases.title: Kefa and First Steps
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement and independently derived valid methods before model benchmark
cases.reviewNote: Track the current nondecreasing run length, reset on a drop, and retain its maximum. This also admits a one-dimensional recurrence.

cases.title: Kefa and Company
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement and independently derived valid methods before model benchmark
cases.reviewNote: Sort friends by money, keep a window whose endpoint difference is strictly below d, and maximize its friendship sum. A prefix-sum plus binary-search variant is valid. Sorting currently lacks a dedicated taxonomy node.

cases.title: Kefa and Dishes
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement and independently derived valid methods before model benchmark
cases.reviewNote: Use a visited-dish mask and final dish as the DP state; append an unused dish with its base satisfaction and adjacency bonus. Only states with m selected dishes are answers.

cases.title: Kefa and Watch
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement and independently derived valid methods before model benchmark
cases.reviewNote: A substring has period d when its prefix and suffix shifted by d agree. Maintain normalized polynomial hashes under range digit assignment using a lazy segment tree. Hash collision handling is an implementation concern.

cases.title: Laptops
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement and independently derived valid methods before model benchmark
cases.reviewNote: Both prices and qualities are permutations of 1..n. If all paired values agree no inversion exists; otherwise an inversion must occur. Sorting followed by an inversion check is another valid method; sorting lacks a dedicated node.

cases.title: Fedya and Maths
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement and independently derived valid methods before model benchmark
cases.reviewNote: The residue of the sum of the four powers depends on the decimal exponent modulo 4; stream the digits to compute that residue. Modular exponentiation by decimal digits is an alternative. A dedicated modular-exponentiation node is currently absent.

cases.title: Beru-taxi
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement and independently derived valid methods before model benchmark
cases.reviewNote: Compute Euclidean distance divided by speed for each available taxi, then take the minimum; no routing algorithm is needed.
